source: evaluation/RESULTS.json plus six candidate decisions/model specifications and source-proposal reviews
main_conclusion: The final data are inspectable assumption-dependent scenario cohorts with partial analytical fidelity; direction agreement coexists with discrepancies in effect size, joint residual dependence and dispersion.
supported_contribution: Concrete complete virtual cohorts constructed from partially informative external summaries under explicit finite-moment laws.
Endpoint-specific descriptive comparison of delivered native-unit effects, residual dependence and dispersion against existing exposed sample references.
Transparent separation of source facts, mathematical transformations and unverified transport/conditioning assumptions makes successes and failures interpretable.
key_findings: All 54 primary point directions agree, but the TC reference sensitivity band crosses zero; direction matching is not robust-sign recovery or quantitative validation.
All three HbA1c age effects exceed the reference point and Q2 BMI effects are smaller; H03 is closer on Q3 but has lower HbA1c variability.
Lipid HDL associations are attenuated, TC association points are larger, and residual Pearson correlations around 0.108-0.141 are well below the reference point 0.512.
L02 has closer TC marginal SD, while all three HDL SDs are below the reference; no single overall winner follows.
No reference is supplied for added lipid conditional-RMS diagnostics, so target accuracy for those quantities is unassessed.
source_use_interpretation: Differences in moment anchors, conditional bridges, dependence and distribution choices describe the laws; this uncontrolled batch cannot causally attribute performance to one source, retrieval action or modeling decision.
limitations: Two previously exposed sample-reference families; no fresh blinded clinical validation or national population truth.
Six constructions share sources, model service and review workflow; 18 tables and 54000 synthetic rows are not independent clinical evidence.
Three seeds per fixed law characterize limited sampling variation, not source, structural or transport uncertainty.
Reference stability/sensitivity bands are not equivalence margins or acceptance thresholds; lipid residual-correlation interval is unavailable.
All six laws were retained and 132 source checks were unavailable, so feedback-driven numerical improvement is not demonstrated.
No controlled baseline establishes retrieval benefit, general superiority, measurement savings or readiness for clinical inference.

decision.scope: Narrow use and claims to task-specific, assumption-dependent scenario cohorts for pipeline prototyping and inspection of declared-law implications.
do_not_claim: Calibrated target effect, power or uncertainty inference
